reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs support it: Section 4.1 imposes only ordinary license fees, Section 11.1-11.3 provide for term/termination and survival with no early-termination fee, minimum-fee buyout, or penalty payable by Corio (the licensee/customer), and Exhibit B payment terms are ordinary net-30 fee mechanics.

Direction is correct — Corio is our party (licensee/customer), and no liquidated damages or penalty runs against it; surviving payment obligations are fees for continued use and support Corio elects to receive, which is not an LD.
No redline or counterparty comment is expected or present for a compliant finding; the rendered text is unchanged from the originals and no deterministic checks failed.

Rationale's characterization of Section 4.4 audit cost reimbursement on a >5% underpayment as cost-shifting rather than liquidated damages is a reasonable reading and does not convert this into a deviation.
